{"diagnosis": "Fetch TB shows TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000 for 2009 cycles with tohost FAIL 0xdead, expected PC advancing through 256 NOPs. mem_done at picorv32.v:376 requires (mem_do_rinst && mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata) so instruction-only mem_xfer never asserts done and fetch stalls at 0. Root cause is && instead of ||; restoring OR restores mem_done for rinst/rdata/wdata.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -375,3 +375,3 @@
 	wire mem_busy = |{mem_do_prefetch, mem_do_rinst, mem_do_rdata, mem_do_wdata};
-	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst && mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
+	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
 			(!mem_la_firstword || (~&mem_rdata_latched[1:0] && mem_xfer));", "expected": "tohost PASS with progress, max_addr advancing beyond 0x00000000 and no TRAP: no progress"}
